subject: Post-POC results snapshot + ask: brief call & permission to share metrics
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@quickcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-POC: quick metrics snapshot + 15-min ask

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for running the POC with us over the last three weeks. We compiled a short snapshot of the results (attached) but the high-level wins looked like this: 

- 22% reduction in average inference latency across peak traffic windows (p50 down from 320ms to 250ms)
- 31% lower per-token cost after enabling prefix caching and a conservative quantization profile
- 99.6% success rate on API calls during the busiest hour (no intervention required)

We'd love to share a one-paragraph customer quote and confirm permission to include the metrics above in a short case snippet. Would you be open to: (a) a 15-minute call this week to confirm the wording, and (b) explicit sign-off on the metrics/attribution?

I attached the PDF snapshot and the updated mutual action plan with next steps. Proposed times: Thu 2/12 10:00–10:15 PT or Fri 2/13 14:00–14:15 PT — or send a slot that works.

If helpful, Ben (cc'd) can draft a one-liner you can edit. Thanks again — team loved working with QuickCart.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: quickcart_poc_metrics_20260210.pdf (PDF), mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (Spreadsheet)

From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@quickcart.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-POC: quick metrics snapshot + 15-min ask

Diego —

Appreciate the summary and the attached metrics — nice work by your team. The numbers match what we saw in our monitoring, and the latency improvements are already noticeable for our checkout assistant flows.

Happy to provide a short quote and give permission to share the metrics with attribution to QuickCart. I can take a look at a draft.

I can do Thu 2/12 at 10:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite.

Quick note: legal asked that any public use include the sentence "QuickCart retained control of customer data and model prompts throughout the POC" — that would be our required line for compliance.

Emma Jensen
Head of Product Integrations | QuickCart, Inc.
Direct: +1 415-555-0199
